      Desserts

      Maha's Best Chocolate Chip Cookies

      Desserts This is the legendary cookie recipe of the great Maha, owner of the Magic Kitchen, and baker of wonders. Eat them and weep with joy.

      This is the legendary cookie recipe of the great Maha, owner of the Magic Kitchen, and baker of wonders. Eat them and weep with joy.

      Print Recipe Pin Recipe
      Prep 20-25 min
      Cook 11-13 min
      Yield 2.5 Dozen

      Ingredients

      Scale
      • 1 Cup Salted Butter
      • 2 Large Eggs
      • 1 Cup Packed Brown Sugar
      • 3/4 Cup Granulated Sugar
      • 3 Cups All-Purpose Flour
      • 1 tsp Vanilla Extract
      • 3/4 tsp Cinnamon
      • 3/4 tsp Salt
      • 3/4 tsp Baking Soda
      • 2 Cups Chocolate chips

      Directions

      1. 1

        Preheat the oven to 350 degrees

      2. 2

        Soften Butter

        Soften the butter by your chosen method. A pan on the stove on medium low works best. If you're in a hurry a microwave works too. You want the butter to be soft all the way through and slightly melted.

      3. 3

        Cream the Wet Ingredients

        Add the softened butter, brown sugar, granulated sugar, vanilla extract, and eggs to an electric stand mixer and mix on medium low speed until you have a light creamy consistency. I find it easiest to just leave it mixing while you mix the dry ingredients.

      4. 4

        Mix the Dry Ingredients

        Add the flour, cinnamon, salt, and baking soda to a separate mixing bowl. Whisk ingredients together.

      5. 5

        Add Dry Ingredients to Wet Ingredients

        A little at a time, add the dry ingredient mixture to the wet ingredients. Leave the electric mixer on a slow mix setting to incorporate the dry ingredients as they get added.

      6. 6

        Add Chocolate Chips

        Either with the mixer on slow speed, or folding in by hand, add the chocolate chips to the cookie dough.

      7. 7

        Bake the Cookies

        Add 2tbsp (standard cookie scoop) balls of cookie dough to a baking sheet. Bake between 11-13 minutes. You'll know the cookies are done when the bottom edge of the cookie looks set and has a nice light golden brown color.
